race.description: The Remington Muswellbrook Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: LAIZABOUT (5) finds a pretty average BM58 here. He has raced in some stronger races at times and has a nice record at this track. Hopefully won't need to get a long way off them from this draw and has run off a quick back up before. FEARN TRICK (3) was much better last outing than the one prior. She has gone her best when leading so may push over from the jump. CHAMBER OF SECRETS (8) has been some time since a win however her whole campaign has been pretty solid. Gets a sweet run. ODE SO MUCH (1) is race fit third up and can measure up with the right run.
